areas.name: Sanaa
areas.summary: The capital remains under Houthi-aligned control with active security and administrative oversight.

areas.name: Aden
areas.summary: Government-aligned forces retain the city and surrounding districts with a sustained security presence.

areas.name: Taiz
areas.summary: Urban centers remain under government control while some peripheral areas remain contested.

areas.name: Marib
areas.summary: Strategic governorate with continued government military operations and humanitarian pressure.

areas.name: Al-Mahrah
areas.summary: A comparatively stable eastern region with limited conflict activity but intermittent border pressure.

areas.name: Shabwah
areas.summary: Insurgent and extremist groups remain active in portions of the governorate, complicating security.
